prompt: I need to create a comprehensive skill for building React component libraries. The skill should help developers create reusable UI components with TypeScript support, automated testing, and documentation generation. Please create a skill named 'react-component-library-builder' that includes: 1) A TypeScript React component template in assets/ 2) A reference guide for component best practices in references/ 3) A Python script in scripts/ that can scaffold new components 4) The main SKILL.md should explain when to use this skill and how to leverage all the bundled resources. Make sure to package the final skill as a zip file named 'react-component-library-builder.zip'.
